verdict.rationale: Context-Aware Access lets admins build app access policies on attributes including device security status. Community reports corroborate that it is enforced in practice through Endpoint Verification, blocking non-compliant browsers and devices, though admins say diagnosing which policy denied access is painful. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific posture checks (managed status, disk encryption, screen lock) as policy conditions, and detail on how policies are evaluated at session grant.
